name: good-vibes-only
description: Personal Claude Code plugins by dinooo13.

plugins.name: usage-limits
plugins.description: Watch Claude Code subscription usage during long jobs, stop cleanly near a limit, and resume the same thread after the window resets.

plugins.name: ship-it
plugins.description: Land a change end to end: verify, PR, babysit CI and reviews, rebase, merge, pull main, install or deploy, check it live, clean up.

plugins.name: review-loop
plugins.description: A fresh reviewer from another model, or a three-provider council, reviews your change; you fix it and repeat until it approves.

plugins.name: fan-out
plugins.description: Take several issues from plan to merged PRs in parallel, with planners, an approval gate, implementers in worktrees, reviews and ordered merges.

plugins.name: handoff
plugins.description: Write a self-contained brief so a new session, T3 thread or /goal run can carry on without this thread's history.

plugins.name: hill-climb
plugins.description: Iterate until an independent critic scores the work at or above a target out of 10, with a fixed rubric, fresh captures and ranked defects.

plugins.name: product-readme
plugins.description: A README that sells the project: one-line value, hero, real screenshots, short install, details moved to sub pages.

plugins.name: web-quality
plugins.description: Lighthouse, Core Web Vitals, SEO and GEO, and a visual pass on phone and desktop, measured before and after.

plugins.name: project-digest
plugins.description: A short, read-only digest of your GitHub projects: who is waiting on you, what is broken, what is ready to merge.

plugins.name: tidy-repos
plugins.description: Delete merged branches and clean worktrees across your repos, and list stale work instead of touching it.
